name: Torr2Jelly
description: TorrServer torrent streaming & Prowlarr/Torznab integration for Jellyfin
overview: Stream torrents instantly on Jellyfin without waiting for downloads. Features direct TorrServer streaming, Prowlarr search, and automated .strm library generation.

versions.changelog: Automatic library deduplication and obsolete file/folder purge: StrmEngine automatically detects and deletes duplicate legacy .strm files and .nfo sidecars when naming schemes/templates change, cleans up empty directories, purges deleted torrent orphans on library sync, and improves multi-season parsing in TitleCleaner.
